main.description: Sends com.atproto.moderation.createReport to the moderation service this appview names, with a service token from the account logged in to its web pages, as `knotless mod report` does. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

reason.description: Why, as com.atproto.moderation.defs names reasons, by the last word of each.

subject.description: What is reported: an account's handle or DID, a repository's knotless:// URL, or the at:// URI of a record, such as a pull, an issue or a comment.

text.description: More on why, for the moderators.

reportId.description: The report's number, as the moderation service gave it.

description: Reports an account, a repository, or what someone wrote about one, to the moderation service, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
